description: WE ARE CREATING A WEBSITE TO MONITOR ASTRONAUT HEALTH
summary: ASTROGUARD is a digital health-support system developed to help astronauts monitor their well-being during space missions. It addresses the challenge of maintaining human health beyond Earth by providing tools to record vital signs, track health trends and identify unusual changes in simulated health readings. Through interactive body exploration, health assessments and visual reports, astronauts can better understand potential health concerns. The platform also offers guidance on nutrition, exercise, hydration and rest to encourage healthier daily routines. ASTROGUARD is important because spaceflight exposes astronauts to unique health challenges, including microgravity, radiation and isolation. By bringing health monitoring and preventive guidance together in one accessible platform, our project aims to support early awareness, informed decisions and safer long-duration space exploration.
details:
ASTROGUARD is a website that we created to simulate how astronauts keep track of their health during space missions. It includes an interactive human body diagram, where users can explore different body parts, enter their health measurements, view changes through charts and receive suggestions on nutrition, exercise, hydration and sleep.

The platform helps astronauts understand their health better, keep track of changes and notice unusual readings. It aims to encourage early health monitoring and help astronauts stay healthy during long missions in space.

ASTROGUARD was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Chart.js was used to display health data, Visual Studio Code for coding and Netlify to publish the website online.

One of the main features of ASTROGUARD is that it brings several health-related tools together in one platform. Instead of checking different sources, astronauts can explore their body systems, monitor their health and get useful recommendations in one place. Throughout the development, our team also considered the health risks of space travel and focused on making the platform informative, easy to use and useful for astronauts.
